title: Pocketwire Personal Account Cash-Out Fee Terms
content:
### Clauses in force

1. A standard cash-out from a Pocketwire Personal Account to a linked bank account is free and arrives within the plan's standard transfer arrival time in business days.
2. Every instant cash-out books an instant transfer fee entry on the transfer date.
3. A customer who is charged the wrong fee because a qualifying card or direct deposit was on file is refunded the difference only as a fee refund of the whole fee followed by a new fee entry at the correct amount; a fee that was correctly charged is never waived as a courtesy.
4. The debit card statuses that qualify a card-holder under these terms are active and locked.

### Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis for the instant transfer fee of the Pocketwire Personal Account:

- the clause setting the fee at 0.00 inside a monthly free quota — the plan's fee-free instant cash-outs increased by the card-holder bonus for a debit card in active or locked status on the transfer date — measured by the instant cash-outs of the calendar month containing the transfer;
- the clause choosing, outside the quota, the direct-deposit instant fee rate when the direct deposits posted in the previous calendar month reached the plan's direct-deposit benefit threshold and the base rate otherwise, the two rates never combining and the free quota taking precedence over either;
- the clause computing the fee as the transfer amount times the applicable rate, rounded to the cent and then raised to the minimum fee or lowered to the maximum fee.

### Correcting a wrong fee (clause 3 restated)

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Fee charged at the wrong amount because a qualifying card or direct deposit was on file | The whole fee is refunded, then a new fee entry is booked at the correct amount |
| Fee charged correctly | Not waived as a courtesy |

superseded_clauses: The fee is 0.00 when the transfer falls inside the monthly free quota, which is free_instant_transfers_per_month increased by card_holder_bonus_free_instant when the customer holds a Pocketwire debit card whose status is active or locked on the transfer date; the transfer falls inside the quota when wallet_msr_instant_count_month is lower than that quota.

Outside the quota, the fee rate is dd_instant_fee_rate_pct when the direct deposits posted in the previous calendar month (wallet_msr_dd_prev_month) are at or above dd_benefit_threshold, and instant_transfer_fee_rate_pct otherwise; the two rates never combine, and the free quota always takes precedence over either rate.
The fee is the transfer amount times the applicable rate, rounded to the cent (half up), then raised to instant_transfer_fee_min when lower and lowered to instant_transfer_fee_max when higher.
